'''Fort Divin''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Antalaha]]. It was named after the [[Divin|first lieutenant]] to command the planet.

==Description==
Fort Divin was the only spaceport on Ord Antalaha. It dealt with a lot of illegal traffic and had a thriving used [[Starship/Legends|starship]] market. The port lacked facilities to deal with any ships bigger than a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] and mainly dealt with converted [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and patrol ships.
